ctx.x: Heh heh heh. I had to put him down as somethin'.
And Norman Siminoff, photography, and Dewey L. Johnson, radio productions. You told me earlier today that Norman Siminoff was a Jewish fellow who taught Sheffield photography. Is that right?

Yeah, I guess he...they came there as partners, and I know Simi had been a photographer long time. I know him on the Avenue. Then when he and Sheffield come out there, he done nearly all the work so I know that Sheffield was learnin' from him.
